metadata.title: Fix iframe errors from replaceState and localStorage
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

Fixes #2777

---

## 📌 Summary
- Guard all `window.history.replaceState()` calls with try-catch to prevent `SecurityError` in sandboxed/cross-origin iframe contexts
- Guard all `localStorage` access with try-catch to prevent crashes when storage is blocked (e.g. sandboxed iframes, restrictive browser policies)
- Add `safeReplaceState()` helper in `admin.html` head script block for reuse across template call sites

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                                 | Command              | Status |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| Lint suite                            | `make lint`          |    pass    |
| Unit tests                            | `make test`          |    pass    |

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed

commits.message:
fix: use safeReplaceState helper consistently and guard sessionStorage in generateUserId

- Replace inline try/catch with safeReplaceState() in admin.js and
  pagination_controls.html for consistency with admin.html
- Guard sessionStorage calls in generateUserId() to prevent
  SecurityError in sandboxed iframe contexts

commits.message:
fix: add runtime fallbacks for safeReplaceState and log-once for restricted contexts

- Define window.safeReplaceState and window._logRestrictedContext
  fallbacks in admin.js for standalone use outside admin.html
- Primary definitions in admin.html head script block
- Use log-once pattern to avoid console spam in restricted contexts
- Add debug logging to all catch blocks including dark mode persistence
